3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.notes: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.notes: When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of Bardic Inspiration. Roll your Bardic Inspiration die and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll, potentially reducing the damage or turning the success into a failure.

6.name: Magical Discoveries
6.notes: Learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell lists. Each chosen spell must be a cantrip or a spell for which you have spell slots. You always have these spells prepared. Whenever you gain a Bard level, you may replace one of these spells with another that meets the same requirements.

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.notes: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add it to the d20 roll. If the result is still a failure, the Bardic Inspiration isn't expended.
